attributes.description: Visualization of 30s metrics in the `elastic-agent diagnostics` output

embeddableConfig.description: Should be near 0, large positive numbers mean the output is not reliably receiving all events sent to it
If this is consistently near the queue size (default 4096) then the inputs are producing events faster than the output can write them.
For maximal through put this should be equivalent to bulk_max_size
